title: Re-cite chatPush capability rule in push.rs docs
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[chat-ext] Re-cite chatPush capability rule in push.rs docs
Spec (57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00.md:110 "If a `PushSubscription/set` create or update includes a `chatPush` entry for an account whose `accountCapabilities` does not include `urn:jmap:chat:push`, the server MUST return an `invalidProperties` SetError whose `properties` names the offending entry (e.g., `chatPush/<id>`) and MUST NOT store the subscription change." (replaces "Servers MUST NOT include `chatPush` entries for accounts whose `accountCapabilities` does not include ...")
Code: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/push.rs:74-77 (validate_chat_push doc quotes removed sentence); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/push.rs:136-149 (strip_unsupported_chat_push justified only by the removed sentence); crate-jmap-chat-server/src/memory.rs:1827; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/chat_push_validation.rs:75,143; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/chat_push_memory.rs:102; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/chat_push_should_push.rs:344
Now: validate_chat_push already rejects the entry with invalidProperties chatPush/<accountId>, and memory.rs:1845/1871 rejects before storing, so the behavior conforms. But the docs and test oracles quote a sentence that no longer exists, and strip_unsupported_chat_push enforces a read-side rule the draft no longer states.
Change: Re-quote :110 in the validate_chat_push docs and test oracles. Decide whether to keep strip_unsupported_chat_push, which the spec now neither requires nor forbids for a capability lost after storage. If kept, re-justify it, for example as matching should_push, which treats such an entry as absent.
